title: Apply a Specific Commit to Current Branch (Cherry-Pick)
code:
git cherry-pick <commit-hash>
# Or to cherry-pick without auto-committing:
git cherry-pick -n <commit-hash>
explanation: Extracts the exact changes introduced in a specific commit from another branch and replays them as a new commit onto your current working branch.
caveat: If conflicts arise, resolve them and run `git cherry-pick --continue`. To cancel and revert cleanly, run `git cherry-pick --abort`.
